statement: An actual genus-one Lefschetz map of Q to S3 gives a positive twelve-node bounding four-manifold for the marked cusp torus. Its relative affine stable-frame Pontryagin defect is minus24 in the Lefschetz boundary orientation gamma-w-u (plus24 in gamma-u-w).
notes: The page-to-q normal-frame rotation has winding minus12 and is stably null. This computes a specified relative framing defect, without yet converting it to the cap cubic or monodromy.
